verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a collection of SKILL.md instruction files installed locally into an agent project. It does not collect, host, or process user data, so a training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product; that control belongs to the agent or model provider. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any data-handling or training-opt-out capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
